name: What are the common signs of a cracked sewer pipe?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a cracked sewer pipe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a cracked sewer pipe include persistent foul odors in your yard or home, unusually lush patches of grass, unexplained wet spots, or indentations in your lawn. Inside your home, you might notice slow drains, gurgling sounds from toilets, or water backing up into sinks or tubs. A significant increase in your water bill without a change in usage can also indicate a leak. Early detection of these signs can help prevent more extensive and costly damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include foul odors, lush spots in your yard, slow drains, gurgling toilets, or an unexplained increase in your water bill.
